title: 第383章 香香渴望的东西
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

香香自出生起，便一直过着心惊胆战的生活。

虽是天香狐族圣女，却依旧步步惊心。

此刻，感受着手中传递来的熟悉温暖，她似乎又回到了那日的小院里。

在她绝望之际，那白衣身影翩然而至护她周全，助她斩了来犯的主脉第二神子！

那一日，男人虽全程冷言，虽满口不耐烦，但那安全感却是香香从未感受过的。

从那一刻起，她的心上便刻下了那道白衣身影！

因出身之故，她从不敢奢求爱情，但那一刻，有一颗名为爱情的种子，已在心底悄然生根发芽……

今日，那熟悉的安全感又出现了。

不同的是，身边的男人不再如那日一般冷言冷语，而是浑身透着让她感觉奢侈的温柔与爱意。

这一刻，美如梦幻。

香香紧紧的握住了大夏龙雀，帝器虽重，但此刻的分量却不足他在她心中的万一。

她带着从不敢想的底气，一步步朝雷灵王狐走去。

“天香狐！本祖乃北域狐族老祖，你敢对本祖动手！！”雷灵王狐的声音中透着急躁和色厉内荏。

话音未落，剑光已然落下。

噗嗤！！！

一道细线自它的脖颈处蔓延，它带着满眼的惊恐和不可置信，脑袋一歪，滚出去了数米远……

“香香姐姐，我们居然把狐族老祖杀了！”小灵儿像是在做梦般，满脸难以置信。

香香转头，美眸中只剩那个男人。

以前从不敢奢望的温暖，此刻就在眼前。

她再也控制忍不住了，飞身扑进了秦然的怀中，柔软的身躯紧紧地贴着他，似乎想把自己融进去一般。

“云江仙，你之前说的话还算吗？”

“哪句？”秦然嘴角含笑。

“睡觉那句！”香香抬起小脸，粉眸中亮晶晶的，那充满依赖和求安慰的目光，柔软到让秦然的心都酥掉了。

他鬼使神差的低头，在女人的樱桃小嘴上轻吻了一口。

亲完之后，他自己愣住了，香香也愣住了。

以前，秦然挑逗过香香，却从未有过如此主动的亲密举动。

小灵儿站在一旁酸酸的，“我是不是有点多余？”

香香的粉眸上，瞬间蒙上了一层水雾。

她香肩轻颤着，香软的小脸上尽是难以置信，她期待了许久许久的那个吻……终于来了。

压抑在心中的情绪，再也控制不住了。

“云江仙，你喜欢我吗？”她泪眼朦胧，小脸上写满忐忑，终于问出了她在心中演练过万次的问题。

“不喜欢！”秦然似笑非笑。

其实，早在香香赖在他身边那一天开始，他就已经将香香当成自己人了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xiangxiang has been living a life of fear since she was born.

Although she is a saint from the Tianxiang Fox Clan, she is still shocking every step of the way.

At this moment, feeling the familiar warmth conveyed in her hands, she seemed to be back in the small courtyard that day.

When she was in despair, the figure in white came to protect her and helped her kill the invading Second Son of God!

That day, although the man was cold and impatient throughout the whole process, the sense of security was something Xiangxiang had never felt before.

From that moment on, that figure in white was engraved in her heart!

Because of her birth, she never dared to ask for love, but at that moment, a seed called love had quietly taken root and sprouted in her heart...

Today, that familiar sense of security appeared again.

The difference was that the man around her no longer spoke coldly like that day, but was filled with tenderness and love that made her feel luxurious.

This moment is as beautiful as a dream.

Xiangxiang held Daxia Longque tightly. Although the imperial weapon was heavy, its weight at this moment was not enough for him in her heart.

With a confidence she had never imagined, she walked step by step towards the Thunder Spirit King Fox.

"Tianxiang Fox! This ancestor is the ancestor of the Fox Clan in the Northern Territory. How dare you attack me!!" The voice of Thunder Spirit King Fox was filled with impatience and fierceness.

Before he finished speaking, the sword light had already fallen.

Poof!!!

A thin line spread from its neck. With eyes full of horror and disbelief, it tilted its head and rolled out several meters away...

"Sister Xiangxiang, we actually killed the ancestor of the Fox clan!" Xiao Ling'er seemed to be in a dream, with a face full of disbelief.

Xiangxiang turned her head, with only that man in her beautiful eyes.

The warmth that I never dared to hope for before is now right in front of me.

She couldn't control it anymore and flew into Kieran's arms, her soft body pressed tightly against him, as if she wanted to melt herself into him.

"Yunjiangxian, does what you said before still count?"

"Which sentence?" Qin Ran smiled.

"That sentence about sleeping!" Xiangxiang raised her little face, her pink eyes were bright, and her gaze was full of dependence and seeking comfort, so soft that it made Qin Ran's heart break.

He lowered his head in a strange way and kissed the woman's cherry little mouth.

After the kiss, he was stunned, and Xiangxiang was also stunned.

Qin Ran had teased Xiang Xiang before, but he had never made such an active and intimate move.

Xiao Ling'er stood aside and said sourly, "Am I a little redundant?"

Xiangxiang's pink eyes were instantly covered with mist.

Her fragrant shoulders were trembling slightly, and her fragrant little face was full of disbelief. The kiss she had been looking forward to for a long time... finally came.

The emotions suppressed in my heart can no longer be controlled.

"Yunjiangxian, do you like me?" Her eyes were filled with tears, and her little face was full of anxiety, and she finally asked the question she had rehearsed in her heart thousands of times.

"I don't like it!" Qin Ran smiled half-heartedly.

In fact, as early as the day Xiangxiang stayed by his side, he had already regarded Xiangxiang as one of his own.
